title: Yet Another Number Game
statementMd:
Since most contestants do not read this part, I have to repeat that Bitlandians are quite weird. They have their own jobs, their own working method, their own lives, their own sausages and their own games!

Since you are so curious about Bitland, I'll give you the chance of peeking at one of these games.

BitLGM and BitAryo are playing yet another of their crazy-looking genius-needed Bitlandish games. They've got a sequence of $*n*$ non-negative integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$. The players make moves in turns. BitLGM moves first. Each player can and must do one of the two following actions in his turn:

- Take one of the integers (we'll denote it as $*a*_{*i*}$). Choose integer $*x*$ $(1 ≤ *x* ≤ *a*_{*i*})$. And then decrease $*a*_{*i*}$ by $*x*$, that is, apply assignment: $*a*_{*i*} = *a*_{*i*} - *x*$.
- Choose integer $*x*$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9bcd77b1a4d70adef53560c92a78c087c5d0039f.png). And then decrease all $*a*_{*i*}$ by $*x*$, that is, apply assignment: $*a*_{*i*} = *a*_{*i*} - *x*$, for all $*i*$.

The player who cannot make a move loses.

You're given the initial sequence $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$. Determine who wins, if both players plays optimally well and if BitLGM and BitAryo start playing the described game in this sequence.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3$).

The next line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} < 300)$.

## Output

Write the name of the winner (provided that both players play optimally well). Either "`BitLGM`" or "`BitAryo`" (without the quotes).
statementZhMd:
由于大多数参赛者不会阅读这部分内容，我不得不再次说明，Bitland 人相当奇怪。他们有自己的工作、自己的工作方式、自己的生活、自己的香肠以及自己的游戏！

既然你对 Bitland 如此好奇，我就给你一个了解其中一种游戏的机会。

BitLGM 和 BitAryo 正在玩另一种看起来疯狂、需要天才才能解决的 Bitland 游戏。他们有一个由 $*n*$ 个非负整数组成的序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。两位玩家轮流进行操作，BitLGM 先手。每位玩家在自己的回合中都可以且必须执行以下两种操作之一：

- 选择其中一个整数（记作 $*a*_{*i*}$）。选择整数 $*x*$ $(1 ≤ *x* ≤ *a*_{*i*})$，然后将 $*a*_{*i*}$ 减少 $*x*$，也就是执行赋值：$*a*_{*i*} = *a*_{*i*} - *x*$。
- 选择整数 $*x*$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9bcd77b1a4d70adef53560c92a78c087c5d0039f.png)，然后将所有 $*a*_{*i*}$ 都减少 $*x*$，也就是对所有 $*i*$ 执行赋值：$*a*_{*i*} = *a*_{*i*} - *x*$。

无法进行操作的玩家输掉游戏。

给定初始序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。假设双方都采取最优策略，且 BitLGM 和 BitAryo 从该序列开始进行上述游戏，请判断谁会获胜。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3$）。

下一行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} < 300$）。

## 输出格式

输出获胜者的名字（假设双方都采取最优策略）。答案应为 "`BitLGM`" 或 "`BitAryo`"（不含引号）。
